title: 第16章 四魔功第17章 药王山
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
丹长老站起身来，道：“我不缺筑基丹，你自己炼化吧！”
沉翔笑道：“那就好！我需要一堆筑基丹，小姑娘，帮我收集材料吧。”
三十九颗青玄果，意味着他需要采集三十九组药草。他不缺千脉果、金灵果、辅助药材、妖丹。在玄武玄境，他已经获得了足够八百筑基丹的炼器材料。他只是想看看丹长老是否真的不缺筑基丹的材料。
丹长老摇头：“上次，我已经竭尽全力去采药了。我不是不想帮你，只是现在金灵果和千脉果都非常稀缺。”
沉翔知道丹长老没有说谎，但他怀疑丹长老就是丹香桃园的院长。不然的话，她怎么能够这么快就采集到这么多炼制筑基丹的草药。
“小姑娘，我问你一件事。你要老实回答我！”
陈翔说道。“你已经知道我拥有火灵，而且我一直对你很好！”
“我可以选择回答或者不回答！”
丹长老回答道。她心里也有些怀疑沉翔想问什么，因为他现在居然这么认真。
沉翔点了点头，问道：“你就是丹香桃园的院长？”
丹长老没有回答，也没有说话，只是看着沉翔。此时，他已经可以证实自己的怀疑了，她确实是丹香桃园的院长。
“不，我不是丹香桃园的院长！不过，我对她很熟悉！”
丹长老否认了沉翔的指控，不过，对于这件事，他却是十分确定。
“你没有骗我吧？”
沉翔有些疑惑。
“我没有骗你！还是要我发誓？”
丹长老说道。
“不！”
沉翔开始采摘那些青玄果，然后说道：“小姑娘，你找到五行真元丹的材料下落了吗？”
“我没有，如果有的话，我会第一个去确认，给你买！”

丹长老一边闻着那朵青花，一边说道。只看一眼，就可以看出她非常喜欢这朵花。
沉翔笑道：“那就先谢谢你了！虽然你以前对我这样，但我从来没有恨过你！嘿嘿，说实话，我很想尽快打败你。我想看看你到底是谁，我也想确认一下你所说的关于你的外表是否属实，你是否真的像我仙仙一样美丽！”
丹长老轻哼一声：“哼，那你就赶紧变强，别惹上什么麻烦。再过几年，整个世界就会有一场浩劫，你要做好应对的准备，认真修炼！”
“如果你想采集一些珍稀药草，最好去丹香桃园的香城看看，那里有拍卖行！我要闭关一段时间。”
content_en:
Elder Dan stood up and said: "I don't lack the Foundation Establishment Pill, you can refine it yourself!"
Chen Xiang smiled and said: "That's good! I need a bunch of foundation-building pills, little girl, help me collect the materials."
Thirty-nine Qingxuan fruits meant that he needed to collect thirty-nine groups of medicinal herbs. He has no shortage of Qianmai Fruit, Golden Spirit Fruit, auxiliary medicinal materials, and demon pills. In the Xuanwu Xuan Realm, he has obtained enough refining materials for eight hundred Foundation Establishment Pills. He just wanted to see if Elder Dan really had no shortage of materials for the Foundation Building Pill.
Elder Dan shook his head: "Last time, I tried my best to collect herbs. It's not that I don't want to help you, but now both Golden Spirit Fruit and Thousand Vein Fruit are very scarce."
Chen Xiang knew that Elder Dan was not lying, but he suspected that Elder Dan was the dean of Danxiang Taoyuan. Otherwise, how could she collect so many herbs for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill so quickly.
"Little girl, let me ask you something. You have to answer me honestly!"
Chen Xiang said. "You already know I have the Fire Spirit, and I've always been nice to you!"
"I can choose to answer or not!"
Elder Dan replied. She also had some doubts about what Chen Xiang wanted to ask, because he was so serious now.
Chen Xiang nodded and asked, "Are you the dean of Danxiang Taoyuan?"
Elder Dan did not answer or speak, he just looked at Chen Xiang. At this time, he could already confirm his suspicion that she was indeed the dean of Danxiang Taoyuan.
"No, I am not the dean of Danxiang Taoyuan! However, I am very familiar with her!"
Elder Dan denied Chen Xiang's accusation, but he was very sure about this matter.
"You didn't lie to me, did you?"
Chen Xiang was a little confused.
"I didn't lie to you! Or do you want me to swear?"
Elder Dan said.
"No!"
Chen Xiang started picking those Qingxuan fruits, and then said: "Little girl, have you found the whereabouts of the materials for the Five Elements True Essence Pill?"
"I don't have it. If there is, I will be the first to confirm and buy it for you!"
Elder Dan said while smelling the blue flower. Just one look at it and you can tell she really likes this flower.
Chen Xiang smiled and said: "Then thank you in advance! Although you have treated me like this before, I have never hated you! Hehe, to be honest, I want to defeat you as soon as possible. I want to see who you really are, and I also want to confirm whether what you said about your appearance is true, and whether you are really as beautiful as me, an immortal!"
Elder Dan snorted softly: "Hmph, then you should quickly become stronger and don't get into any trouble. In a few years, there will be a catastrophe in the whole world. You must be prepared to deal with it and practice seriously!"
"If you want to collect some rare herbs, you'd better go to Xiangcheng in Danxiang Taoyuan. There is an auction house there! I'm going to retreat for a while."
